name: windblog-grafana
desc: Same-origin Grafana embed for the WindBlog admin. The short-lived auth_token query parameter is converted to the X-JWT-Assertion header and to an HttpOnly cookie so the iframe keeps working after the first request.

functions:
local core = require("apisix.core")
return function(conf, ctx)
    local token = ngx.var.arg_auth_token
    local cookie = ngx.var.cookie_windblog_grafana_jwt
    if token and token:match("^[%w%._%-]+$") then
        core.request.set_header(ctx, "X-JWT-Assertion", token)
        ngx.header["Set-Cookie"] = "windblog_grafana_jwt=" .. token .. "; Path=/observability/grafana/; Max-Age=900; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax"
    elseif cookie and cookie:match("^[%w%._%-]+$") then
        core.request.set_header(ctx, "X-JWT-Assertion", cookie)
    end
end
